profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | MIT ‘21, SM ‘23
profile.summary: I am a Master's candidate in the MIT Aeronautics and Astronautics department, researching multi-fidelity aircraft design. My Master's thesis will present a framework for efficient multi-fidelity optimization-centered approach to aircraft design, with an example application of designing a regional electric passenger aircraft. I have interned in the past at Boeing, Lockheed Martin, and Electra.aero working on various tools for aircraft design and analysis and now currently looking for full time aircraft design roles to pursue after I graduate in June 2023.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: - Software development for the Aerospace Toolbox Fixed Wing Object

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant - Aerospace Computational Design Lab
positions.description:
- Conceptual design of electric passenger aircraft using physics-based models with optimization and trade studies on market demand and certification against aircraft-level design requirements
- Researching novel parametric aircraft design based on optimization guided design decisions
- Developed visual debugging capabilities on Computational Aircraft Prototype Syntheses (CAPS) for analysis modules and data transfers

positions.title: Conceptual Design Intern
positions.description:
- Developed additional functionality for analysis in mission performance codes
- Collaborated using the Agile development framework

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: - Designed and optimized propellers for the Electra Short Takeoff and Landing aircraft.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher - Laboratory for Aviation and the Environment
positions.description:
- Designed wing spar structural experiment to validate models used for design and optimization
- Wrote a 1D Euler equations solver to simulate Electro Aerodynamic internal thruster flow behavior
- Generalizing MATLAB electrostatic solver to model various corona discharges, decoupled thrusters, etc.

positions.title: Conceptual Design Intern
positions.description:
- Developed algorithms for mission performance codes
- Optimal climb methods implementation, test, and validation

positions.title: Aircraft Developer - Earth Signals and Systems Group
positions.description:
- Designed endurance tiltrotor vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) for earth and atmospheric field research and data collection
- Optimized wing and empennage design for controllability, aerodynamics and stability during forward flight and transition, as well as robustness in payload fitting and autopilot 
- Programmed a MATLAB dynamical forward flight simulation which interfaces with an external joystick to simulate various missions

positions.title: Aero Stability and Control Intern
positions.description:
- Analyzed flight test instrumentation and evaluated impact on model for S&C analysis and simulation
- Upgraded automatic data visualization Python tools for 777X and future flight tests
- Produced aero model and simulation results to streamline comparison of data calculation processes
- Collaborated with interns on developing future commercial aircraft to meet market demands

positions.title: Satellite Commanding and Telemetry Programmer
positions.description:
- Implemented laser calibration algorithm; telemetry and commanding communications for Cubesat Lasercomm Infrared CrosslinK (CLICK) experiment. 
- Integrated CPU-Bus Interface software for Nanosatellite Optical Downlink Experiment 
- Wrote TVAC test scripts for experimental CubeSat configuration to sample deformations and shifts

company.name: MIT Space Telecommunications Astronomy and Radiation Laboratory

positions.title: Summer Research Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and modeled the Passive Gravity Offload System, a versatile sandbox environment with constant overhead offloading force to test the first Korean moon rover in lunar gravity conditions and simulate tread on lunar surface.
- Analyzed structural loads and power requirements as well as methods of effective power transmission and loads over several meter lengths

company.name: Korea Institute of Science and Technology

educations.fieldOfStudy: Aeronautical and Astronautical Engineering; BS, Electrical Engineering and Computer Science

volunteerExperiences.description:
